headline: The ARChitects climb from 798th to 16th on ARC-3

sections.text: The ARChitects gained 9.02 points to reach 38.85, leaping from 798th to 16th on the public board.
That puts the team inside the provisional gold places: the line stands at 19th with 38.20.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
